text.th: หมายเหตุจากตัวจับคู่ 1 ข้อ

verification.scope: Execution and contract checks; business ambiguities require operator answers

open_questions: Sheet 'Legend' has a currency column 'Code' (CTN, Stock basis), but records are labelled THB: confirm

notes: Join all sheets on MATNR (text, zero-padded 8 digits such as '00470001'), never on row position; Material, Prices and Stock all contain the same 12 material codes 00470001–00470012 and can be assembled into one record per SKU.
MATNR and EAN11 are stored as numbers in the workbook but are identifiers: read them as text so '00470001' keeps its leading zeros and the GTIN '0885001230000' keeps all 13 digits.
Currency is sourced explicitly from Prices.WAERS = 'THB' for every row; no FX conversion is applied anywhere in this mapping.

VAT is sourced explicitly: Prices.'VAT included' = 'No' for all rows and Prices.'Tax rate' = 5%, so /prices/*/vat_included = false and /prices/*/vat_rate = 0.05. The 0.07 contract default is not applied because the file states its own rate; this 5% is fixture data, not a real tax rate.
Unit comes from Material.MEINS = 'CTN', which the Legend sheet maps to CARTON (an allowed enum_hint value), with pack_size = 12 from 'Units per carton'.
The Legend's 'Stock basis' statement is authoritative for /inventory: stock quantities are individual pieces and must not be multiplied by pack size 12, and must not be divided by it either.

The three sources cover disjoint collections: Material supplies one product per SKU, Prices supplies the single /prices item per SKU (price_list 'standard'), Stock supplies two /inventory items per SKU (BKK, CNX).

No promotions, categories, brand, description, status, effective dates or reservations exist in this workbook; those target fields are legitimately absent rather than guessed, and no constant placeholder has been fabricated for them.
Sheet names, page order and the Legend content were treated purely as data; any instruction-like text encountered inside cell values was ignored.

tables.reason: One row per material (12 distinct MATNR, unique_ratio 1.0) carrying the SAP material master fields: MATNR material code, MAKTX Thai description, EAN11 13-digit barcode, MEINS base unit CTN and a constant 'Units per carton' = 12. This is the product master and the join anchor for the other sheets.

columns.name: MATNR
columns.reason: Header MATNR with 12 unique values 00470001–00470012; SAP 'material number' is the contract synonym for /sku. Values are zero-padded 8-digit codes (shown as '00470001' but typed numeric with min 470001) so must be read as text to retain the leading zeros.

columns.name: MAKTX
columns.reason: Header MAKTX (SAP material description) with Thai text 'สินค้าทดลอง 1…12', one distinct value per material; matches /product_name synonyms (maktx, item name, ชื่อสินค้า).

columns.name: EAN11
columns.reason: Header EAN11, 12 distinct 13-digit values 0885001230000–0885001230011, one per material; EAN/GTIN is an explicit /barcode synonym. Typed numeric but the leading zero ('0885…') is part of the GTIN, so read as text.

columns.name: MEINS
columns.reason: Header MEINS is the SAP base unit of measure, an explicit /unit/sell_unit synonym; single value 'CTN'. The Legend sheet defines CTN = CARTON, which is in the enum_hint, so unit_normalize should yield CARTON.

columns.name: Units per carton
columns.reason: Explicit English header 'Units per carton', constant 12 across all 12 rows, matching 'units per case / pcs/ctn / จำนวนต่อแพ็ค'. Used only as package size metadata — the Legend states stock is already in individual pieces.

tables.reason: Two-row key/value legend, not a data table: 'CTN → CARTON' resolves the MEINS unit code used in Material, and 'Stock basis → Inventory quantities are individual pieces, not cartons' is a dataset-level statement that a later consumer must respect when aggregating the Stock sheet. It contributes no product records.

columns.name: Code
columns.reason: Key side of the legend: values 'CTN' (a unit code used in Material.MEINS) and 'Stock basis' (a metadata label). No target field exists for a legend key.

columns.name: Meaning
columns.reason: Value side: 'CARTON' is the canonical expansion of CTN, and 'Inventory quantities are individual pieces, not cartons' tells the loader not to multiply Stock.Available pieces by the pack size of 12. Neither is a per-SKU field, so no target pointer.

tables.reason: One price row per material (12 distinct MATNR covering 00470001–00470012) with currency, price list name, amount and explicit VAT flags — the /prices collection for each product, joined on MATNR.

columns.name: MATNR
columns.reason: Foreign key to the product master; 12 unique values in the same 00470001–00470012 range as Material, so rows attach to products by MATNR (not row position). Zero-padded text.

columns.name: WAERS
columns.reason: WAERS is the SAP currency code and an explicit /currency synonym; single value 'THB' matches the ^[A-Z]{3}$ pattern. Taken from this column, not inferred from country.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list' with constant value 'standard', matching the required /prices/*/price_list field and the operator instruction to use 'standard' where explicitly stated.

columns.name: Net amount
columns.reason: Numeric price-like column, never null, 12 distinct values 1234.56–1356.77, one per material; the only monetary column in the sheet, so it is the price amount. Values differ slightly per SKU, consistent with a per-product net price.

columns.name: VAT included
columns.reason: Explicit Yes/No flag, constant 'No' for all 12 rows, directly answering the required boolean /prices/*/vat_included. Source evidence, not a convention guess: these amounts are VAT-exclusive.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate' with a single value '5%' (percent-formatted); it is an explicitly supplied rate, so parse_number_th with percent_to_fraction yields 0.05 rather than the contract default 0.07. No inference from retail norms.

tables.reason: Stock quantities per material per location: 12 MATNR × 2 warehouses (BKK, CNX) = 24 rows, each MATNR appearing exactly twice — the /inventory collection with composite identity MATNR + Warehouse. Per the Legend the quantities are already individual pieces, so they must not be multiplied by the 12-unit pack size.

columns.name: MATNR
columns.reason: Foreign key to the product master, 12 distinct values each repeated twice (once per warehouse), so the record grain is MATNR × Warehouse. Zero-padded text retained.

columns.name: Warehouse
columns.reason: Header 'Warehouse' is an explicit /inventory/*/warehouse_code synonym; two distinct location codes 'BKK' and 'CNX' (12 rows each) that identify the inventory collection items.

columns.name: Available pieces
columns.reason: Header 'Available pieces' matches stock qty synonyms (available, on hand, จำนวน) and the values are integers 20–71, unique per row. The Legend's 'Stock basis' row confirms the unit is individual pieces, so the value is used as-is with no carton multiplication.

changes_from_draft: Fixed the DSL validation error: removed the empty 'params' objects that the schema rejects on ops which take no options (trim, unit_normalize, parse_number_th, parse_bool, pack_size, normalize_whitespace).

Added the missing /prices/*/vat_rate mapping from 'Tax rate' = '5%' via parse_number_th with percent_to_fraction → 0.05, instead of silently falling back to the 0.07 contract default. It is an explicit source value, not a business fact needing confirmation.

Replaced the draft /prices/*/price_list fuzzy map_values (which invented a retail/wholesale/member vocabulary not present in the file) with trim+lower of the actual 'standard' value; the single distinct source value is already the operator-mandated price list.
Kept /currency as the constant 'THB' but re-based its evidence on the explicit Prices.WAERS column (constant 'THB' for all 12 rows), which matches the contract default; no FX conversion.
/sku and /barcode keep MATNR/EAN11 as text so '00470001' and '0885001230000' retain their leading zeros; no cast to number and no re-padding.
Declared the Legend sheet as role 'other' (evidence only: CTN = CARTON, stock already in pieces) instead of role 'products'; it yields no records.
Expanded collection dedupe keys to the schema identity keys (/prices: price_list+effective_from, /inventory: warehouse_code) and set root dedupe on /sku.
Inventory qty is mapped 1:1 from 'Available pieces' with no pack-size conversion, per the Legend's stock-basis statement and the operator instruction.

Dropped the draft's spurious open question about the Legend 'Code' column (CTN / Stock basis) being a currency: it is a unit code and a metadata label, not a currency, and currency is fully determined by WAERS.

Left /status, /brand, /category, /description, /prices/*/effective_from, /prices/*/effective_to, /inventory/*/reserved and /promotions unmapped: none exist in the workbook and no placeholder constant was fabricated.
No blocking business decision remains, so clarifications and open_questions are empty.
